content.summary: A riverside library and public market progress through fixed-view dated construction ladders. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Each site uses one fixed recoverable coordinate. + Exact dates advance monotonically. + Every construction state inherits the prior site boundary. + The second site repeats the same state grammar independently. + The final view compares two completed locations without coordinate drift.
quick_start.recommended_input: Fix one aerial coordinate over an original riverside library site and display exact year labels 1970, 1995, 2010, 2020 and 2028. Raise the same library mass through frame, roof and finished facade while prior context persists. End on a split view of both completed civic sites with the exact line TWO PLACES / ONE CITY.
